product.title: Day Trip to Zaanse Schans, Edam, Volendam and Marken from Amsterdam

description.text: Discover the Dutch countryside on this full-day tour to Zaanse Schans, Edam, Volendam, and Marken from Amsterdam. Windmills, waterlands, cheese makers, and clog workshops are covered with a professional guide, plus tastings of local produce and interior visits. Round-trip coach transfer from central Amsterdam keeps village timing coordinated. The outing is built for visitors who want a Holland countryside day without self-driving between fishing villages. Stops include Zaanse Schans, Edam, Simonehoeve, Marken.
